$schema: Task state for the harness. The orchestrator owns this file; subagents read it. One file => one owner across tasks (the harness assumes you keep ownership disjoint).
spec: Add server-side search to Link Shelf with a typed API and a debounced React UI.

tasks.title: Search query + index in the data layer
acceptance: searchBookmarks(q) returns matches ranked by title then url
empty query returns [] without hitting the store

tasks.title: GET /search endpoint
acceptance: contract documented for the frontend: GET /search?q= -> {id,title,url}[]

tasks.title: Debounced search box + results list
acceptance: renders empty + loading + error + results states
named export, design tokens for styling
